newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN EXTENDING THURSDAY GAINS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN EXTENDING THURSDAY GAINS.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rise for the fifth session running on Friday as Thursday's strong buying after fixing signalled that large investors are taking advantage of relatively low prices.

Analysts said some investors might be shifting funds from neighbouring bourses such as Budapest, which recently hit highs while Polish shares suffered due to macroeconomic concerns and the recent flooding.
They said the bourse may have put the effects of the Monday rate rise behind it but warned that more rapid growth could lead to a downward correction early next week.
They said 16,500 points could provide resistance, with some investors still likely to refrain from buying before the September 21 parliamentary elections.
The main market's all-share WIG index closed on Thursday at 15,930.4 points.
